person_note: Ford County is an eligible prose collection whose component stories use different controlling persons. The Goodreads evidence directly exposes third-person narration in 'Michael's Room'; the gnomic Jell-O quotation is nondiagnostic. Authorized excerpts independently establish third-person narration in 'Blood Drive' and 'Fetching Raymond,' while the Tier B whole-collection analysis identifies 'Quiet Haven' as first person and the other six stories as third person, corroborated by an explicit 'Quiet Haven' review. Therefore the book is ALTERNATING. Confidence is medium—not high—because the quote evidence covers only the third-person strand and no authorized excerpt of the first-person story was located.
